propositions: The wheel probe currently runs only a shallow import test (import rebar + entry-point calls + JSON walk) and misses subpackage import breakage, scripts-module sys.path resolution errors, and stale optional-dependency allowlists.

A new deterministic two-leg import walk (scripts/check_import_walk.py) walks every rebar.* module via pkgutil and imports each with importlib, collecting all failures (not fail-fast) and reports each with its traceback.
Scripts modules must be imported in isolated child processes with scripts/ and CWD stripped from sys.path to prevent one script's sys.path.insert from masking a sibling's missing insert.

Expected-optional modules (rebar._mcp_auth, rebar.opcert_service.app, rebar.review_bot.app) are attempted; they record as skip only when ModuleNotFoundError.name matches the declared dep and the dep is absent, otherwise they fail.
The walk is wired into the wheel-probe CI step and locally runnable (make import-walk target) without CI dependency; documented in docs/releasing.md.

Regression tests (RED-first in tests/scripts/test_check_import_walk.py) recreate the pre-fix bare-import leak (spinal-grayish-perch alert_dedup shape) and verify the walk catches it and reports all failures simultaneously.
